time.source: Paper Table II and the M1 contract. Landing hover remains 5 s and only starts at a registered pad.

motion.wind_source: Synthetic calm. Wind is not estimated in M1.3.
motion.start_state: Landed at the registered pad. Remote backhaul and wait stay airborne and keep hover propulsion. Airborne wait is subject to the return-reserve check. Only return, after the pad radius and speed gates and the landing hover, turns propulsion off.

geometry.note: Same pads and buoys as M1. Geometry is not refit to create a calibration benefit.

belief.quadrature: Gauss-Legendre weights on the quantile coordinate u in (0, 1). Mission node count is the segmented candidate that passes, or the frozen 15-point rule when that check is NOT_MET.
belief.source: Support matches Table II. Kernel std and noise stay the M1 synthetic contract.

utility.formula: J = on_time_bits / b_ref - lambda_e * sum_m energy_used_j / e_ref
utility.source: Same shape as paper equation (7). Scales stay the M1 values.

energy.bulk_source: Synthetic short-range data-product radio. Not LoRa and not an old service radius.
energy.battery_rule: tight stays 52156.035109573495 J. loose is the M1.2 insensitive vector and is not recomputed. window is (L+U)/2 only when L < U for every UAV, with L = untruncated calibration cost at theta_ref plus the post-calibration far completion quote at the design-noise posterior q95 plus reserve, and U = the pad far completion quote at the prior q95 plus reserve. epsilon_design = NormalQuantile(0.95)*sigma. The same vector is used for every true-theta base. Do not search another battery after rewards.

radio.reuse: LoRa airtime, current and the M0A k=4/3 horizon. Commands, acks and telemetry are LoRa. The bulk product is not credited on LoRa.

lookahead.terminal: One decision interval of physical rollout plus one best remaining business. The business quote includes backhaul, return and landing, and that cost is charged in the value. Cached bits and a new target are alternatives, not a sum. The other UAV waits. gamma=1. Not an exact Bayes optimum.
lookahead.noise: Noise is integrated by monotone posterior-q95 breakpoints on the standard-normal CDF coordinate. The frozen fallback is 5-point Gauss-Hermite. Zero noise is not the planning expectation.

integral.tie_rule: Among scores within tie_abs, pick service by ascending buoy id, then backhaul, return, wait, calibrate. This band stays 0.0001 and is not widened to a measured gap.
integral.frozen_rule: If no segmented candidate meets q_abs_tol inside the rollout budget, every mission scores with 15-point Gauss-Legendre on the posterior quantile coordinate and 5-point Gauss-Hermite noise, then the same tie rule. Mark frozen_approximation and numerically_sensitive. Do not raise the budget or keep a failed grid.

development_states.name: calibration_switch
development_states.note: Narrow posterior near the end of the registered calibration pattern.

integral.selection: Smallest theta candidate whose segmented noise integral matches the independent piecewise reference within q_abs_tol on every development state. A failed candidate is not kept. Mission utility is not read.

matched_planner: Both methods call the same finite lookahead and the same frozen scoring rule. The only switch is whether calibrate is in the candidate set.
ablation: At most the first calibration in each window base, and only if that calibration happened. Two continuations share the post-calibration physical state and then forbid further dedicated calibration.
